import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("phase")
parser.add_argument("--profile", action="store_true")
arguments = parser.parse_args()
if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*", arguments.phase) is None:
    parser.error("phase must be a lowercase name")
owner = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repository_root = owner.parent.parent
phase_directory = owner / arguments.phase
setup_command = ["mise", "exec", "--", "bun", "run", str(owner / "setup.ts")]
subprocess.run(setup_command + ["setup", arguments.phase], cwd=repository_root, check=True)
try:
    material = json.loads((phase_directory / "material.json").read_text())
    environment = os.environ | material["environment"]
    jobs = {
        "types": ["test", "scripts/package/candidate/external-consumer/type-acceptance.test.ts"],
        "artifact": ["test", "scripts/package/artifact/artifact.test.ts"],
        "function": ["run", str(owner / "function-check.ts")],
    }
    with (phase_directory / "samples.jsonl").open("x") as evidence:
        for job, command in jobs.items():
            for sample in range(1 if arguments.profile else 3):
                executable = ["mise", "exec", "--", "bun"]
                if arguments.profile:
                    executable.extend([
                        "--cpu-prof", "--cpu-prof-md",
                        f"--cpu-prof-dir={phase_directory}",
                        f"--cpu-prof-name={job}-{sample}",
                    ])
                with (phase_directory / f"{job}-{sample}.stdout.log").open("w") as stdout:
                    with (phase_directory / f"{job}-{sample}.stderr.log").open("w") as stderr:
                        started_at = time.perf_counter()
                        process = subprocess.Popen(
                            executable + command, cwd=repository_root,
                            env=environment, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                        )
                        _, status, usage = os.wait4(process.pid, 0)
                        process.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
                        row = {
                            "phase": arguments.phase, "job": job, "sample": sample,
                            "profiled": arguments.profile,
                            "wallMs": (time.perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000,
                            "cpuMs": (usage.ru_utime + usage.ru_stime) * 1000,
                            "maxProcessRssKiB": usage.ru_maxrss,
                            "exitCode": process.returncode,
                            "candidateVersion": material["candidateVersion"],
                            "command": executable + command,
                        }
                        evidence.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
                        evidence.flush()
                        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
                        if process.returncode != 0:
                            raise RuntimeError(f"{job} failed; inspect {phase_directory}")
finally:
    subprocess.run(setup_command + ["cleanup", arguments.phase], cwd=repository_root, check=True)
